QuestInfo.name: Phantom's Other Hideaway
QuestInfo.1: You found another Secret Storage Room in Ariant. The lock is still in place, which could mean he hasn't been there just yet. Breaking the lock is the only way you're getting in. You hope he won't be mad. The lock looks kinda expensive.
QuestInfo.2: You went to the Secret Storage Room in Ariant to track Phantom down, but still couldn't find him. His box was empty, so maybe he already came and left.
